text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaahahahaha! ...Heh. This won't be like 
last year. We're going to make this the 
finest summer training camp ever.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
None shall bind me! Leg issues, public 
opinion—all are mere ancient tales of the 
past!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The sunlight governing rebirth awaits us! 
All to make this the ultimate summer 
training camp.
